title: Jack Roberts — screen-share-led long-form with a dramatic opening
creator: Jack Roberts
operator_priorities: Keep the strong eye-catching opening as an explicit directing requirement.
Retain screen share as the primary body format.
Reuse and tag inspected catalog mechanisms before proposing new graphics.

coverage.transcript: YouTube en-orig auto captions, whole transcript read; paraphrases are contextual, not verified quotations.
limits: All 222 representative state frames and all 101 selected native frames were visually inspected. This is not frame-by-frame human review of all 55,637 frames.
State filenames use state-start time; representatives may be later within the run. Exact PTS is available only for the selected native frames.
No independent factual verification of the creator’s model/pricing claims.
No compiled verified style pack, rendered adaptation, or end-to-end playback qualification.
~1 Mbps video compression limits subtle motion measurement.
Detector cuts, motion events and deduplicated states are different counts; none alone defines editorial pacing.
The native-cadence deep pass retains all 1,324 detected events and 16 unclassified motion runs. Unclassified runs still need interpretation for a production shot plan.
Research OCR reads all 222 states. Per-event graphic text timing and the separate caption OCR pass were explicitly skipped; these measurements are unmeasured, not absent.

geometry.basis: Manual visible bounds in native source frame 0; approximate pixel estimates, not a universal layout preset.
geometry.appearance: Rounded browser and square camera mask with soft shadow over blurred blue desktop/background.
geometry.priority: Screen is primary; do not cover the datum, input, result or comparison label with the presenter.
geometry.adaptation: Choose inset location/size per actual UI. Hide or relocate with an intentional cut where needed; avoid a 50/50 split for dense screens.

pacing.warning: Detector measures high scene-change candidates, not all tab changes or editorial cuts. The initial hero is held ~10.1s; previews last ~6.2s and ~2.2s; diagram is held ~18s. Do not install these values as universal constants.
pacing.transition_policy: Use captured page transitions and clean tab changes. Separate screen-region crossfades from full-canvas cuts. Smoothness means intentional continuity, not effects everywhere.

sequence: Immediate cost/benefit premise over a dramatic legible hero
Return to the main idea and explain the mechanism
Move into the real interface, then deliver both previewed results later
avoid: A slow generic intro before the premise
Rebuilding the entire demonstrated application as motion graphics
Adding recurring editorial zooms that these samples do not establish
Copying claims or exact timings into an unrelated episode

inspection.observation: Rounded, shadowed device frame with real image/video/HTML screen slots; explicit paused timeline; optional swap fades out before fading the next screen in.
inspection.limitations: Browser/window defaults to 16:10 and min(82cqw,126cqh), which is narrower than this reference. Source has a 0.9s entrance and slight drift; reference frame is already present and essentially fixed. Do not double-frame captured browser chrome. Native video slot synchronization and repeated-instance behavior need qualification.
inspection.adaptation: Keep the shell only when footage needs it; fit the actual capture aspect, hold the frame steady, retain native media timing. Presenter is a separate native media layer.

inspection.observation: Kicker then large headline, 1.2s entrance, restrained drift and 0.55s exit, editable headline/kicker.
inspection.limitations: This reference opens with its centered sans title and italic secondary line already visible. The candidate is left-aligned, adds a delayed entrance, and has no italic subtitle variable or beam.
inspection.adaptation: Reuse type hierarchy for an original opener if appropriate; prefer a captured own hero page for this reference. Do not label the unchanged template an exact match.
inspection.fit: gap: opening title is not immediate/centered in this unchanged template

inspection.observation: Three blurred gradient fields, deep/bright mood and blue accent; one sine cycle per mounted duration.
inspection.limitations: Atmosphere only: no vertical light beam, whale mark, or flowing horizon. Motion uses onUpdate, so suppressed-event seeking must be tested/adapted before native use.
inspection.adaptation: Retain atmosphere only if a new original hero is required; use own mark and a separately evidenced beam gap. This study creates no new custom effect.

inspection.observation: 1920x1080 SVG bars, lines, donut or progress; exact supplied value tokens, one emphasized datum; 3.3s build plus elastic hold, hold exit.
inspection.limitations: White-card layout differs from the reference dark-page chart. Nominal 30fps count rows; reference is 60fps. Values and labels must come from our verified evidence; timing must fit new narration.
inspection.adaptation: Use type=bars, own labels/data and one accent emphasis for an original evidence graphic; keep screen recording when demonstrating the actual page.

inspection.observation: 1920x1080 opaque dark card; up to five numbered rows, header-first then staggered rows, holds through cut.
inspection.limitations: Vertical rows differ from the reference three side-by-side cards and illustrated chapter sections. Useful functional match, not an exact layout replica.
inspection.adaptation: Configure three steps for our own chapter roadmap. Retain its working animation; captured own deck is preferable when the deck itself is being demonstrated.

inspection.observation: A screenshot slot, focus anchor and clamped pan/zoom, setter-driven camera for suppressed-event seeking; zoom cue, optional halo and held end.
inspection.limitations: Screenshot-only port, not a drop-in live screen-recording player. Proposed readability improvement; these selected reference bursts do not establish repeated editorial punch-ins.
inspection.adaptation: Use only for a source-backed still detail that needs enlargement. For a live interaction, use native media framing, avoid inventing actions, and preserve orientation.

inspection.observation: Pointer with configurable size/tone/pulse and host-driven x/y custom properties; click ring animation recipe.
inspection.limitations: Does not derive pointer paths from screen recordings. A second pointer would duplicate the captured cursor. Native binding, timing and multiple instances remain unqualified.
inspection.adaptation: Prefer the recorded cursor; add a pointer only for an authored explanation with an explicit path and a visible actual result.

inspection.observation: Outgoing/incoming opacity classes with an optional flat/bloom wash and host timeline recipe.
inspection.limitations: Default recipe creates a wash and differs from the observed overlapping page crossfade around 341.6s. A whole-frame fade would incorrectly fade the persistent presenter/browser.
inspection.adaptation: For original deck pages, apply only inside the screen region; omit the wash for a plain crossfade. Retain hard tab changes and the final hard presenter cut.
